spec.description:
Modify an existing order's parameters in place, without cancelling and replacing it: Kraken-assigned and client-assigned order identifiers stay the same, queue priority in the order book is preserved where possible, and if the amended quantity drops below the already-filled quantity the remaining quantity is cancelled.

**API Key Permissions Required:** `Orders and trades - Create & modify orders` or `Orders and trades - Cancel & close orders`

request.title: AmendOrderRequest
request.description: Parameters for amending a live order in place.

txid.description: The Kraken identifier for the order to amend. Either `txid` or `cl_ord_id` is required.

cl_ord_id.description: The client identifier for the order to amend. Either `txid` or `cl_ord_id` is required.

order_qty.description: The new order quantity, in terms of the base asset.

display_qty.description: For `iceberg` orders only, the new quantity to show in the book while the rest of the order quantity remains hidden. Minimum value is 1/15 of the remaining order quantity.

limit_price.description: The new limit price (for order types that support a limit price). May use relative pricing: `+`/`-` prefix as an offset from the reference price (e.g. `+50` or `-100`), optionally suffixed with `%`.

trigger_price.description: The new trigger price (for triggered order types only). May use relative pricing: `+`/`-` prefix as an offset from the reference price, optionally suffixed with `%`.

pair.description: Required on amends for non-crypto pairs, e.g. the pair symbol for xstocks.

post_only.description: For `limit_price` amends only. If true, the limit price change is rejected unless it can be posted passively in the book.

deadline.description: RFC3339 timestamp (e.g. `2021-04-01T00:18:45Z`) after which the matching engine should reject this amend if it is still queued due to latency, minimum now()+2s, maximum now()+60s.

response.title: OrderAmendedFrame
response.description: Wire frame; the generated method returns `result`.

error.description: Wire envelope field; see the core.

result.title: OrderAmended
result.description: Result of amending a live order.

amend_id.description: The unique Kraken identifier generated for this amend transaction.

notes: `nonce` is dropped from the request body -- transport-injected by the client core (authed_request), never a caller-supplied parameter.

Upstream's `required` list holds only `nonce`: despite prose stating 'either txid or cl_ord_id is required', neither is formally marked required in the schema, so none of AmendOrder's fields end up required here.
See the amend transaction guide (https://docs.kraken.com/docs/guides/spot-amends) for further detail, linked from upstream's description but not independently verified here.
